ResearchProjectDef.label: soul scooping
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to seal the soul of a worthy dead colonist in a bottle by hand (right-click their body within half a day of death), and to sculpt guardian statues. Success depends on the extractor's Intellectual skill.

ResearchProjectDef.label: soul engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Powered machines for souls: the soul storage, the automatic soul extractor, and soul batteries that hold MP.

ResearchProjectDef.label: soul transformation
ResearchProjectDef.description: The soul transformer: bind a stored soul to a guardian statue and wake it as a guardian made of mana.

ResearchProjectDef.label: soul invigoration
ResearchProjectDef.description: The soul invigorator: return a superior guardian's soul to its own preserved body. Difficult, endgame technology.
